name: CTF orchestrator (VMI CyberFusion)
description: An AI agent loop that proposes a command, runs it in a throwaway Kali container, reads the output and tries again. Flask and Socket.IO backend, ephemeral Docker containers. It solved the VMI challenges well inside the time limit.
